{
  "dataset_name": "bank_marketing",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "call_duration_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed call duration normalized by training mean and std, providing a smooth continuous score of call engagement intensity",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "call_engagement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log normalization reduces skewness of duration distribution, creating a smooth linear-friendly feature capturing call engagement",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(duration) - np.log1p(259.857)) / (np.log1p(259.857 + 266.790) - np.log1p(259.857))"
    },
    {
      "name": "economic_stress_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of economic indicators: employment variation rate, consumer price index deviation, and euribor rate, capturing macro-economic environment stress",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "economic_context",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of correlated economic features reduces dimensionality and provides a single smooth economic stress axis for SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.4 * emp.var.rate + 0.3 * (euribor3m - 3.618) / 1.736 + 0.3 * (cons.price.idx - 93.575) / 0.576"
    },
    {
      "name": "campaign_intensity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse log-scaled campaign contact frequency, where fewer contacts score higher, reflecting diminishing returns of repeated outreach",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "campaign_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized score captures non-linear relationship between contact frequency and outcome, linearized for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 / (1.0 + np.log1p(campaign - 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "previous_contact_recency_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Recency score based on pdays: 0 if never contacted (pdays=999), otherwise inverse normalized days since last contact",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "campaign_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts pdays into a smooth recency signal that linearizes the relationship between prior contact timing and subscription likelihood",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays >= 999, 0.0, 1.0 - pdays / 999.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age normalized to zero mean and unit variance using training statistics, providing a smooth continuous demographic feature",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized age enables proper SVM margin computation without scale dominance from raw age values",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 40.146) / 10.404"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_risk_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite financial risk score combining default status, housing loan, and personal loan indicators into a weighted severity measure",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single continuous risk score captures financial obligation burden, providing a smooth linear feature for SVM decision boundary",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.5 * np.minimum(default, 1.0) + 0.3 * np.minimum(housing, 1.0) + 0.2 * np.minimum(loan, 1.0)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "consumer_confidence_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Consumer confidence index normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max, where higher values indicate more positive consumer sentiment",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "economic_context",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized consumer sentiment provides a smooth bounded feature capturing macro-economic mood relevant to financial decisions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(cons.conf.idx - (-50.8)) / ((-26.9) - (-50.8))"
    },
    {
      "name": "prior_campaign_success_signal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined signal from previous contacts and outcome: weighted sum of previous contact count and poutcome success indicator",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "campaign_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures historical campaign engagement quality as a smooth composite, providing strong linear signal for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.4 * np.minimum(previous / 6.0, 1.0) + 0.6 * np.where(poutcome == 1, 1.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_job_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized interaction between education level and job category, capturing socioeconomic profile as a continuous composite",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cross-feature interaction approximates socioeconomic status as a linear projection useful for SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education / 7.0) * 0.5 + (np.minimum(job, 11.0) / 11.0) * 0.5"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_market_tightness",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized employment level deviation from minimum, combined with employment variation rate direction, capturing labor market conditions",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "economic_context",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized employment market indicator provides continuous economic context feature for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((nr.employed - 4963.6) / (5228.1 - 4963.6), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_channel_recency_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of contact channel quality and timing: cellular contact combined with recent month timing scores higher for engagement potential",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "campaign_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures interaction between contact method and seasonal timing as a smooth composite score for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.6 * contact + 0.4 * (1.0 - np.abs(month - 4.5) / 9.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "holistic_engagement_propensity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic assessment of a client's propensity to engage with a term deposit offer, integrating age life-stage suitability, financial stability signals, economic environment favorability, and campaign interaction quality into a single continuous score from 0 (very low propensity) to 1 (very high propensity)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantically rich composite feature that approximates a linear projection of multiple engagement dimensions, directly useful as a smooth SVM margin feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
